rules.text: SikaRoof® VersiScape Panel is a safety panel for use with SikaRoof® VersiJack® to provide a raised substructure that acts as a safety net in case of accidental paver breakage
rules.heading: DESCRIPTION

rules.text: All holes, joints, and cracks and honeycombs in concrete or masonry surfaces shall be filled with an approved grout and allowed to cure
rules.heading: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION

rules.text: SikaRoof® VersiScape Panel shall be loosely laid without any mechanical fixing on top SikaRoof® Versi- Jack®. For fastened application, the panel may be screwed to the pedestal at allocated pilot screw features with approved screws
rules.heading: APPLICATION
